input.body: ## Step to reproduce 1. Fresh start the app 2. Tap Start Tutorial 3. Complete the Tutorial with creating 3 Thoughts with 1 Thought that has 2 subthoughts 4. Do not select anything on Tutorial step 10 (the last page) 5. Tap on the Thought with **unexpanded** subthoughts 6. Tap Step 9 dot on the tutorial 7. See the tutorial copy message ## Current behavior The last sentence of the tutorial says > Tap "_name of the thought_" to reveal its subthought ''=pin". **Screenshot** **Video:** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a5c48c42-9868-48fe-a983-7a7ddf639a6e ## Expected behavior Tutorial message should show that user needs to select another thought with no subthoughts first @raineorshine Please help with the expected behavior for this use case
input.title: Incorrect thought detection on Tutorial message: Tap a thought to reveal its subthought ''=pin"
